NFL DFS Projections Week 12: DraftKings Picks, Values and Sim Plays

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 29 · 9 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 27, 10:32 PM ET

Trevor Lawrence carries the highest SPAGS model projection on the Week 12 DraftKings main slate: 21.8 DraftKings points at $6,700. He holds 24% of the simulated winning-lineup credit across 50,000 simulations. Jakobi Meyers holds the largest share at 37% for $4,500.

Behind Lawrence, the model's next four projections are Joe Burrow (21.6, $7,700), Ja'Marr Chase (20.6, $8,900), C.J. Stroud (20.5, $6,500) and Bijan Robinson (20.4, $7,700). Trevor Lawrence returns the most per dollar of that group at 3.26 projected points per $1,000. Ja'Marr Chase leads the wide receivers at 20.6 for $8,900, Trevor Lawrence leads the quarterbacks at 21.8 for $6,700, and Trey McBride leads the tight ends at 16.1 for $6,600.

The 9-game slate runs from a 48.5-point total in NO at CIN down to 34.5 in NE at LAC. Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 27, 10:32 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup credit comes from 50,000 simulations of the contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th.

Quarterbacks: Week 12 DraftKings projections

Trevor Lawrence, JAX vs TEN ($6,700)

Trevor Lawrence carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 21.8 DraftKings points at $6,700, the highest on the entire main slate. That is 0.3 points clear of Joe Burrow. The model includes 3.5 rushing attempts. The salary works out to 3.26 projected points per $1,000, 3rd of 12 at the position. Across 50,000 simulations Lawrence averaged 21.8 points with a simulated floor of 8.4 and a ceiling of 40.1, and he holds 24% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Jacksonville is a 14-point favorite at home against Tennessee, with an implied team total of 31.25 in a game totaled at 48.5.

Joe Burrow, CIN vs NO ($7,700)

Joe Burrow projects 2nd at the position with 21.6 DraftKings points at $7,700, 2nd on the main slate overall. The salary works out to 2.80 projected points per $1,000, 9th of 12 at the position. Across 50,000 simulations Burrow averaged 21.6 points with a simulated floor of 8.5 and a ceiling of 39.7, and he holds 13% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Cincinnati is a 9.5-point favorite at home against New Orleans, with an implied team total of 29 in a game totaled at 48.5.

Value: Anthony Richardson Sr., IND vs NYG ($4,800)

Anthony Richardson Sr. projects for 16.2 DraftKings points at $4,800, which works out to 3.37 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 12 quarterbacks the model projects for 15 or more points. The model includes 6.4 rushing attempts. Across 50,000 simulations Richardson averaged 16.2 points with a simulated floor of 6.3 and a ceiling of 29.5, and he holds 2% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Indianapolis is a 5.5-point underdog at home against the Giants, with an implied team total of 18 in a game totaled at 41.5.
